translations.de: Hallo, wie geht es dir heute?

phrases.text: Good morning, have a nice day.

translations.es: Buenos días, que tengas un buen día.
translations.ar: صباح الخير، أتمنى لك يوماً سعيداً.
translations.pt: Bom dia, tenha un bom dia.
translations.de: Guten Morgen, einen schönen Tag noch.
translations.en: Good morning, have a nice day.

phrases.text: Thank you very much for your help.

translations.it: Grazie mille per il tuo aiuto.
translations.en: Thank you very much for your help.

phrases.text: You are welcome, it is a pleasure.

translations.ar: على الرحب والسعة، إنه من دواعي سروري.
translations.de: Gern geschehen, es ist mir ein Vergnügen.
translations.en: You are welcome, it is a pleasure.

phrases.text: Excuse me, could you help me?

translations.pt: Com licença, você poderia me ajudar?
translations.en: Excuse me, could you help me?

phrases.text: Nice to meet you, my name is Alex.

translations.es: Gusto en conocerte, mi nombre es Alex.
translations.pt: Prazer em conhecê-lo, meu nome é Alex.
translations.fr: Enchanté de vous rencontrer, je m'appelle Alex.
translations.de: Freut mich, Sie kennenzulernen, mein Name ist Alex.
translations.it: Piacere di conoscerti, mi chiamo Alex.
translations.en: Nice to meet you, my name is Alex.

translations.fr: À plus tard, prends soin de toi.
translations.de: Bis später, pass auf dich auf.
translations.it: Ci vediamo dopo, prenditi cura di te.
